summary: _ansible_remote_tmp is the base directory where the module's tmpdir property creates a random directory if the action plugin didn't set _ansible_tmpdir; see the shell plugin's remote_tmp.
questions: Where does a module create its temp directory if none was provided?

answer_card.title: _ansible_remote_tmp
answer_card.answer_md: If `_ansible_tmpdir` isn't set, `module.tmpdir` creates a randomly named directory under `_ansible_remote_tmp`, which comes from the shell plugin's `remote_tmp` option.
